title: Length-guarded machine scan
statement:
For a machine format $F$, define a partial function on finite bit strings as follows. Decode the input using the pair decoder, obtaining a bit string $b$ and a remainder $r$; if $r$ has length less than $(4k+5)3^{k+1}(
u(b)+1)$, where $k$ is the parameter of $F$ and $
u(b)$ is the natural-number code length of $b$, return no value, and otherwise return the result of applying $F$’s scan operation to the original input.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the pair decoder, the code-length function, or the scan operation, so their precise mathematical meanings cannot be stated from the provided definitions.
